title: UPLIFT participants' PSLE posting groups and educational outcomes
asked: Mr David Hoe asked for the proportion of UPLIFT participants placed in posting groups 3, 2, and 1 or equivalent academic streams after PSLE in each of the last five years, and whether MOE has seen improvements in their posting or other educational outcomes over time.
response: Mr Desmond Lee said UPLIFT has been scaled up through integration with ComLink+, a whole-of-society effort for lower-income families with children. He said latest data for 2023 and 2024 shows about 70% of ComLink+ families with school-going children had all children attending school regularly and progressing to post-secondary education institutions. More detailed data is in MSF's Supporting Lower-Income Households Trends Report, and because ComLink+ launched in 2023, more time is needed to observe trends.

key_points.point: UPLIFT has been scaled up through integration with ComLink+, a whole-of-society effort led by the Government to support lower-income families with children.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: the work of the Uplifting Pupils in Life and Inspiring Families Taskforce (UPLIFT) has been scaled up through integration with ComLink+

key_points.point: In 2023 and 2024, about 70% of ComLink+ families with school-going children had all children attending school regularly and progressing to post-secondary education institutions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: in 2023 and 2024, about 70% of ComLink+ families with school-going children had all children attending school regularly and progressing to post-secondary education institutions

key_points.point: More detailed data is publicly available in MSF's Supporting Lower-Income Households Trends Report.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: More detailed data is publicly available in the Ministry of Social and Family Development’s (MSF's) “Supporting Lower-Income Households Trends Report”.

key_points.point: ComLink+ was launched recently in 2023, so more time is needed to observe trends from efforts under ComLink+.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: As ComLink+ was launched recently in 2023, we will need more time to observe trends arising from efforts under ComLink+.

key_points.point: The 70% outcome is attributed to holistic wrap-around support from agencies, SSAs, community groups and corporates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: it is a result of the efforts to provide holistic wrap-around through integration of support from various agencies and SSAs, as well as community groups and corporates.

key_points.point: Members who know community groups doing homework or mentoring support are encouraged to link them up with the ComLink Alliance Working Group.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: I would encourage the Member or all Members who know of these groups to link them up with the ComLink Alliance Working Group

key_points.point: After-school support includes mentoring, learning journeys, and interest-based activities like photography, sports and arts, not just academic or homework support.
key_points.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
key_points.quote: They also provide mentoring, they provide learning journeys, interest-based activities like photography, sports, arts and so on.
